meta.name: Harikatha Sambhavami Yuge Yuge
meta.description: When 'god' goes on a killing spree in an idyllic village, a police officer with a traumatic past gets inadvertently pulled into the mystery.

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Traumatised by a grave injury and his wife's death in a Naxal attack, police officer Virat goes to his friend Bharat in Araku. Meanwhile, mysterious murders are happening here.

videos.title: Unsleeping Forest
videos.overview: Virat starts investigating Bharat's death. While people believe that God is killing the villagers, Virat connects the murders with the performances of a local theatre troupe.

videos.title: Vamana's Third Step
videos.overview: Virat attends a play with his team and identifies possible victims. As the play progresses, a villager goes missing and he goes looking for him in the forest.

videos.title: Dark Hours
videos.overview: A tragic past haunts Rangachary, and it revolves around his granddaughter, Vaidehi. Another play happens in the village, and Virat zeroes in on the prime suspect.

videos.title: Aham Bramhasmi
videos.overview: Born in a low caste, Das and his mother are shunned by the villagers. Years later, when he meets Vaidehi, he finds another mother in her.

videos.title: Kalki
videos.overview: Fuelled by the need to seek retribution, the last avatar takes centre stage during a performance. Will all the village demons finally be slayed?
